entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Author: Juvvadi Sridevi
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2024
 in/and
 Criminal Petition No.3402 of 2024
Common Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. by the petitioner/accused to quash the proceedings against him in Spl.S.C.No.166 of 2022 on the file of Sessions Court for Trial of SC/ST Cases-cum-VII Additional District and Sessions Judge, Ranga Reddy District at L.B.Nagar,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 3(1)(r)(s),
3(2)(v) of SC/ST of POA Act, 2015.

2. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioners as well as the respondent No.2,
that during pendency of the present Criminal Petition, the parties have compromised the matter and accordingly, I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2024 have been filed to record the compromise between them and to compound the offences.

3. Vide order dated 21.11.2024, this Court directed the parties along with their respective counsel to appear before the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad, for identification and to submit a report.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Pursuant to the above said direction issued by this Court, the parties have appeared and the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, has identified the parties and submitted a report,
dated 02.12.2024 and the same is placed on record.
5.
In view of the above, I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2024 are allowed.

Consequently, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner/accused in Spl.S.C.No.166 of 2022 on the file of Sessions Court for Trial of SC/ST Cases-cum-VII Additional District and Sessions Judge, Ranga Reddy District at L.B.Nagar,

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, Ranga Reddy District at L.B.Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
